_comment: THE RATIO IS THE DESIGN, THE NUMBER IS TUNING (docs/market_spec.md, open question 4).
Each sheet is priced at roughly what selling its fragments' worth of teardown yield
would take, times the fragment count, so scrip is a real alternative to the grind
without being faster than it for every sheet. Sheets whose result gates a region
(the spawner cage, the netherite pattern) are priced past a casual balance. Every
offer is one file; a pack retunes or removes any of them without a mod release.
